_comment: One list of what the gates scan. The Go quality ratchet and the file-size ratchet each had their own, and they disagreed: tools/ and scripts/ were in neither, so the code that checks the code was itself unchecked. Both read this file. The TypeScript-only gates (lint, type escapes, duplication) scope themselves to packages/stow-s3 and are listed separately so that widening a Go scan does not silently widen a TypeScript one.
